# MWITools — licence

**MWITools v26.4.17** by **bot7420, shykai, Stella** (GreasyFork script 494467) declares its
terms in its own userscript header:

```text
// @name         MWITools
// @namespace    http://tampermonkey.net/
// @version      26.4.17
// @author       bot7420, shykai, Stella
// @license      CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
```

<https://greasyfork.org/en/scripts/494467-mwitools>

The script ships no separate licence file and carries no copyright line beyond that `@author`,
so the licence it names — Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0
International — is summarised below and linked in full. This is a pointer to the licence text,
not a quotation of the upstream project; the upstream statement is the five header lines above.

Full text: <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/legalcode>

**Portions of MWITools were adapted and modified** for use in Toolasha — see `README.md`
beside this file for exactly which portions and where they live in `src/`. Every adapted
portion was rewritten against Toolasha's own modules, storage and UI; the changes are noted
per item. Toolasha is non-commercial and is itself published under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, so the
ShareAlike term is satisfied.

The MWITools script itself is **not kept in this repository**; only these notes are. It is a
47,000-line bundle and nothing in Toolasha builds against it. The version number above is what
makes the attribution checkable, and the script can be fetched from the GreasyFork URL when a
claim in `README.md` needs re-reading.
